lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the blurred gill region. Centroid spacing is relatively consistent with a slight horizontal expansion moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid pattern on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller and more concentrated than the primary constellation seen on the lateral flank.
